summary: The contract contains exactly 30 legal bit positions, so the algorithm always performs 30 API calls and a constant amount of work regardless of the hidden value.

workload_bound.source_constraint: 1 <= n <= 2^30 - 1 and legal queries satisfy 0 <= num <= 2^30 - 1

replacement_checks.evidence: The accepted reference loops over the fixed range 0 through 29, issuing one singleton-mask query and doing constant work per position.
Authored cases cover the minimum, maximum, lowest bit, highest bit, sparse values, all bits, and complementary alternating patterns.
